Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Nb centers in both octahedral and square-pyramidal environments, while Li adopts a tetrahedral fluorine coordination. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between Li tetrahedra and Nb octahedra, as well as corner-sharing between Nb octahedra and Nb square pyramids.
